name: estradiol + estriol
uses:
Use • Helps relieve vaginal dryness associated with decreased estrogen levels.
• Provides estrogen support for feminine care needs.
otcwarn: Do not use Do not use if you have had: • Breast cancer • Estrogen-dependent cancer • Unexplained vaginal bleeding Ask Doctor Ask a doctor before use if you have a history of blood clots, heart disease, or liver problems. Stop Use Stop use and ask a doctor if: • Unusual vaginal bleeding occurs • Severe discomfort develops
